snippet.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Vice City, USA.
Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them. But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida — forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive.

Check out the new Launch Trailer, featuring new music from electronic duo Justice, composers of the original score from Grand Theft Auto VI.

The new standalone Justice single, “Flower in a Hurricane” feat. Tame Impala, SZA, and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard, is also available on Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, the official soundtrack which is currently available to pre-save on all major music streaming services and up for pre-order on vinyl or CD at https://gtavi-thealbum.com.

Listen to “Flower in a Hurricane” now: https://justice.lnk.to/flowerinahurricane

This trailer was captured entirely in-game from a PlayStation 5.

Grand Theft Auto VI arrives November 19.

snippet.title: SHEKELI -THE HEAVENLY ECHOES MINISTERS || OFFICIAL VIDEO || 6K-@THE EDGE ©2026
snippet.description:
SHEKELI is one of the Heavenly Echoes Ministers Kenya Songs that Narrates the bible Context about Jesus and Peter.

 Biblical Foundation: Matthew 17:24–27

"Shekeli" is a joyful celebration of Jehovah Jireh, the God who provides in extraordinary and unexpected ways. Inspired by the miraculous account of the coin found in the mouth of a fish, this song reminds us that God's wisdom surpasses human understanding, His power is not limited by our circumstances, and He remains the ultimate source of our provision.

Do your part, and leave the rest to God! Life demands effort, perseverance, and faith, but there are moments when human strength and understanding reach their limits. Shekeli calls us to labour diligently while trusting God with what lies beyond our control. The God who knows our needs can open unexpected doors, turn seemingly impossible situations around, and bring forth provision from places we would never have imagined.

From Struggle to Celebration: The song captures the beautiful transformation of pain into testimony. The aching muscles, difficult seasons, discouraging voices, and moments when success seemed impossible can become reminders of how far God has brought us. He restores lost smiles, renews hope, and gives us fresh reasons to rejoice. When God turns our struggles into testimonies, our response should be gratitude, joyful celebration, and praise. The shouts of joy are not without reason; they are an expression of hearts overwhelmed by the goodness of God! 

Keep a Diary of His Faithfulness: The call to take up a shajara—a diary—and write down God's works carries a profound spiritual lesson. We must not allow the passing of time to erase the memory of His goodness. Record the prayers He answered, the doors He opened, the battles He brought you through, and the blessings you never anticipated. On difficult days, yesterday's testimonies can remind you of God's faithfulness and renew your confidence in Him. Every new chapter is an opportunity to witness His goodness afresh.

Restoration and New Beginnings: Drawing inspiration from God's promise to restore the years consumed by the locusts (Joel 2:25), Shekeli celebrates renewed hope, recovered joy, and the possibility of a better tomorrow. Yesterday does not have to define today. God can breathe new life into weary hearts, restore what has been lost, and usher us into seasons marked by renewed purpose and thanksgiving. Every new dawn is another reason to trust Him and rejoice in His goodness.

May this song strengthen your faith, renew your hope, and awaken a spirit of joyful thanksgiving within you. May you recognise God's hand in both the extraordinary miracles and the everyday blessings, remain diligent in your endeavours, and never forget to celebrate His faithfulness. And when He comes through for you, take up your diary, record the testimony, and give Him the glory!
